stm.current_exhibit: Abstract Landscape with Blue and Green Tones

Abstract Cityscape with Reflections.last_description: An abstract painting depicting a city skyline with tall buildings rendered in warm browns, oranges, and muted blues, reflected in a shimmering water surface below. The composition uses vertical brushstrokes and blended colors to evoke an urban scene at dusk or dawn.

Winter Landscape with Snow-Covered Field.last_description: A landscape painting depicting a snow-covered field with tall, dry grasses in the foreground and a distant treeline under a pale blue sky. The scene is rendered in soft, muted tones of white, beige, and brown, suggesting a cold, serene winter atmosphere.

Landscape with Path and Autumn Trees.last_description: A landscape painting depicting a winding path through a wooded area with autumnal trees, rendered in soft earth tones and muted greens and yellows. The artwork is mounted on a wall, slightly angled, with visible brushwork suggesting an impressionistic style.

Ocean Sunset Landscape.last_description: A vertical painting depicting a dramatic ocean sunset with vibrant orange and pink hues in the sky transitioning into deep blue clouds above turbulent waves. The artwork is mounted on a wall, slightly angled, showing a dynamic seascape composition.

Abstract Cityscape with Vertical Forms.last_description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring blurred, upright forms in warm earth tones and muted reds, suggesting a city skyline. The artwork is mounted on a wall, partially cropped at the edges, with soft brushwork and indistinct details.

Cityscape with Snowy Streets.last_description: A blurred painting depicting a city street scene under snowfall, featuring indistinct buildings and figures in muted blues, grays, and whites. The artwork is mounted on a wall, viewed at an angle.

Cityscape with Water Reflection.last_description: A watercolor-style painting depicting a city skyline reflected in a body of water, rendered in muted blues, grays, and whites. The composition features tall buildings along the horizon with soft, blended edges, suggesting an atmospheric or misty urban scene.

Abstract Landscape with Blue and Green T.last_description: A blurred abstract painting featuring dominant blue and green hues, suggesting a landscape or natural scene. The composition appears to include vertical and horizontal brushstrokes, possibly depicting trees or water, mounted on a museum wall.

Abstract Cityscape with Blue Tones.last_description: A large abstract painting depicting a cityscape with blurred vertical forms suggesting buildings, rendered in shades of blue and gray. The composition features soft, blended brushstrokes and a reflective surface at the bottom, possibly representing water or a street scene.

Coastal Landscape with Sandy Shore.last_description: A landscape painting depicting a coastal scene with a sandy shore, calm blue water, and a distant hillside covered in greenery under a pale sky. The artwork is mounted on a wall and appears to be framed.
